name: episode_clone
title: Clone an episode
description: Creates a clean draft branch from an existing top-level episode: a separate version for comparison or a workshop reset that the user explicitly wants. The clone copies that one episode's source-backed segments, timeline music, overlays, title/copy, aspect ratio, caption setting, and project, but it does not copy rendered media, publish state, origin recording ownership, or revision history. A new reel from Project sources is one episode_create with ordered source ranges, and an in-place change to the current draft is an episode_edit; a clone is neither.

episode_id.description: Top-level episode public ID to branch from. A recording id alias (src_...) resolves to that recording's episode-of-one.

title.description: Optional title for the clone. Defaults to 'Copy of <source title>'.

description.description: Optional description for the clone. Defaults to the source episode's displayed description.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-stable key for safe retry of the same clone request.

examples.label: Branch an episode before trying an alternate cut

source_episode_id.description: Episode public ID the clone branched from.

cloned_from_episode_id.description: Alias for source_episode_id for lineage displays.

cloned_from_revision.description: Source episode revision captured by the clone.

revision.description: Durable revision counter, always 1 for a fresh clone.

segments.description: The cloned segment manifest (index, source_id, source_range, episode_range, boundary).

edge_warnings.description: Always present. Non-mutating warnings for cloned cut edges that land strictly inside transcript words.

at_seconds.description: Recording source time for the flagged edge. This legacy field name is not Episode time.

source_id.description: Recording containing the flagged source edge.

occurrence_id.description: Exact created-target occurrence containing this edge, when mapped.

episode_seconds.description: Exact flagged point on the created target's Episode clock, usable directly as an episode_zoom edge; occurrence_id identifies its source side.

status.description: Always draft — cloned but not rendered.

workspace_url.description: Same-origin path that opens the new clone in the composite editor.

already_applied.description: true when this idempotency_key already created the same clone and the existing clone was returned.

next_action.description: Suggested next tool call: episode_edit on the clone at its current revision.
